topics.title: Start
topics.teach: Read the route. The pre-check is the official assessment, opened from your program page.

topics.title: Sky
topics.teach: Name a real use of the sky, such as navigation, farming, fishing, or a calendar. Say why stars are hard to see in the daytime.

fields.name: daylight
fields.label: Why stars are hard to see in the daytime

items.label: A steady light that does not make its own light
A quick streak that can burn

topics.title: Place
topics.teach: Hours and the eastern horizon are right ascension. The north-south degrees are declination.

fields.name: reason
fields.label: Why does that eyepiece magnify more?

topics.title: Star lines
topics.teach: Order the four star families the way the year moves, then name one family and its season.

fields.name: note
fields.label: One family and the season when it dominates

topics.title: Time
topics.teach: Makahiki follows the moon. Clock time is equal hours. Awakea is the sun at its highest.

fields.name: explain
fields.label: How solar time and clock time differ

topics.title: Light
topics.teach: Rainbow wavelengths are visible light. Bending in a new material is refraction. Radio waves are part of the electromagnetic spectrum.

fields.name: match
fields.label: Absorption and emission for the same element

topics.title: Spectroscope
topics.teach: Build order is fold, grating, tape, then look. Sunlight is a continuous rainbow. A compact fluorescent lamp shows separate bright lines. Do not look at the sun or a laser.

fields.name: safety
fields.label: A bright source you must not look at

topics.title: Wrap
topics.teach: Connect the sky with light in a few sentences.
